name: Vern
tagline: A small private address book that nudges you before a birthday or when a friendship cools
description: Vern keeps everyone in a small private address book and watches two things: birthdays coming up, and friendships that have gone quiet too long. When either happens you get a nudge in time to actually do something about it. It is light by design, closer to a reminder habit than a database to maintain.
author: ahoop
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
